newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Middle East environment talks called next month.
newsitem.headline: Middle East environment talks called next month.

text.p: Japan's ambassador to Israel invited Israel on Monday to the next Middle East talks on the environment, to be held in Spain next month, the foreign ministry said.
The ministry said in a statement the meeting would be held on March 10 in Valencia, Spain, as part of multilateral working groups which have not met since last June.
Five groups -- on the environment, economic development, arms control, water and refugees -- were created at the Madrid Middle East peace conference in 1991 to discuss regional issues.
The ministry said the Japanese ambassador, whose country chairs the environment group, invited Arab parties including Syria and Lebanon to the meeting.

It said the United States and Russia, the sponsors of the multilateral talks, told Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy they would convene a steering committee meeting on March 20 to revive the work of the multilateral groups.
